TS0350001.message: Capture `{captureId}` could not apply optional observer opening `{openingId}` during {phase}.
TS0350001.solution: Inspect the observer failure and retry its operation after correcting the cause. The observer diagnostic does not change the normal source operation outcome.

TS0350002.solution: Retry the original stop after the source call exits; retain its original resource identity.

TS0350003.message: Capture `{captureId}` lost its cluster ownership claim.
TS0350003.solution: Let the current owner continue from the durable position; do not restart the fenced process.

TS0350004.solution: Restore the retained SRS log or stop with state purge and perform a full reload. Do not resume from a newer cursor; a CDC-only baseline requires explicit acceptance of the missing interval.

TS0350005.message: Pipeline `{pipeline}` source `{source}` has retained progress without a proven independent recovery boundary.
TS0350005.solution: Keep the retained state for diagnosis. Perform a full reload, or explicitly accept a new CDC-only baseline and the missing interval; state is not cleared automatically.

TS0350006.message: Shared capture `{chain}` has no recoverable SRS write-through log.
TS0350006.solution: Configure durable SRS log storage before starting shared capture. An independent source channel may be used with SRS disabled.

TS0350007.message: Capture `{captureId}` had no change ring open after {seconds}s and this member could not take it over, so the pipeline had nothing to attach to.
TS0350007.solution: Check that the member holding the capture is running and that every member can reach the coordination store, then start the pipeline again.

TS0350008.message: The cluster refused writes for table `{table}` for {seconds}s, so the capture stopped.
TS0350008.solution: Check that every member can reach the coordination store and see the others; start the pipeline again once the cluster reports its full membership.

TS0350009.message: The cluster refused reads of change ring `{ring}` for {seconds}s, so the source stopped.
TS0350009.solution: Check that every member can reach the coordination store and see the others; start the pipeline again once the cluster reports its full membership.

TS0350010.message: Cannot start consuming from `{value}`; expected `earliest`, `latest`, or an ISO-8601 timestamp.
TS0350010.solution: Set start_from to earliest, latest, or an ISO-8601 timestamp like 2026-07-11T00:00:00Z.

TS0350011.message: Cannot start consuming at `{requested}`; the replay buffer only goes back to `{earliest}`, and its retention is `{retention}`.
TS0350011.solution: Start at or after that point, widen the source's srs retention and let the buffer refill, or read the source directly instead.

TS0350012.message: The capture stream emitted table `{table}`, which this pipeline did not select.
TS0350012.solution: Update the source table selection or verify the connector emits the configured table names.

TS0350013.message: The snapshot of chain `{chain}` reported no position for the change tail to resume from.
TS0350013.solution: This source cannot hand its full load over to an incremental tail; read it as snapshot only, or use a connector build that reports a stream position.
